test_cases.name: Normal triage voi issues hon hop severity
test_cases.description: Triage khi wf-fix-bugs Lane Dispatch da tao issue-registry.json voi mix CRITICAL/HIGH/MEDIUM
expected_behavior: Step 2.0: Scope filter apply (all → pass all, $TARGET_DIRS+$TARGET_ROUTES rong → fallback PASS)
Step 2.0b: Issue IDs assigned (ISSUE-001, ISSUE-002, ISSUE-003)
Step 2.1: compile_error → CRITICAL, test_failure → HIGH, lint_error → MEDIUM
Step 2.1a: customer.ts → domain='sales', invoice.ts → domain='finance'
Step 2.2: compile/lint → AUTO_FIX, test_failure → AGENT_FIX
Step 2.3b: issue-registry.json UPDATED (giu nguyen type/source/file_path, them severity/batch/fixability/domain/out_of_scope)
Step 2.7: User confirmation prompted (dry_run=false, Protocol 16 CDG)
Step 2.8: phase-summary.md created (tieng Viet, <=15 dong, sections: Da lam gi/Ket qua/Can luu y/Buoc tiep theo)
POST-GATE: fix-status.json.phases.phase_2.status='completed', progress_pct=30, active_skill='wf-fix-bugs', next_action='phase_3_execute', output_files.phase_summary set

test_cases.name: Dry-run mode — tao day du file nhung khong chay execute
test_cases.description: Triage trong dry_run mode — tat ca 4 files van duoc tao de Phase 6 Report co the generate
expected_behavior: Tat ca steps 2.0-2.6 va 2.8 van chay binh thuong
Step 2.5: Hien thi message dry-run + set next_action='phase_3_execute' (execute tu skip Phase 3-5)
Step 2.7 SKIP (khong hoi user xac nhan khi dry_run=true)
Step 2.8: phase-summary.md van tao (non-technical, tieng Viet)
POST-GATE: fix-status.json updated binh thuong, next_action='phase_3_execute' (execute tu detect flags.dry_run de skip Phase 3-5, chi chay Phase 6 preview)
NOT_expected: Skip tao bat ky file nao (ke ca phase-summary.md)

test_cases.name: Khong co issues sau scope filter — empty triage
test_cases.description: wf-fix-bugs Lane Dispatch co tim ra issues nhung tat ca ngoai scope $TARGET_DIRS
expected_behavior: Step 2.0: TAT CA issues marked OUT_OF_SCOPE (gan flag `out_of_scope=true` tren tung issue)
Sau scope filter: $DISCOVERED_ISSUES effective = empty

T004 empty handling: Tao bug-triage.md trang (Total=0, khong co severity tables) + fix-plan.md (No batches) + fix-log.json (init voi entries=[]) + phase-triage.md (tieng Viet 'Khong co loi can fix'). **KHONG UPDATE issue-registry.json** (giu nguyen do wf-fix-bugs Lane Dispatch tao — POST-GATE schema check T4 SKIP khi .issues rong)
Update fix-status.json: phase_2.status='completed', issues.by_severity all 0, issues.out_of_scope=N
STOP voi message 'Khong co issues trong scope de fix'
active_skill='wf-fix-bugs', next_action='phase_3_execute' (execute se detect 0 fixable issues va skip sang Phase 6)
NOT_expected: Ghi issue-registry.json voi severity/fixability/domain (vi phong doi khong co issues trong scope)
Fail POST-GATE vi .issues[0] khong co severity

test_cases.name: Deep scan voi orphan UI issues
test_cases.description: Triage voi --deep flag — orphan UI issues duoc xu ly rieng trong bug-triage.md
expected_behavior: Step 2.0a: $ORPHAN_UI_ISSUES loaded tu deep_scan_state (2 orphan items)
Orphan issues KHONG merge vao $DISCOVERED_ISSUES — xu ly rieng
Step 2.3: bug-triage.md section 'UI→Docs Gap Analysis (--deep)' co 2 rows
Step 2.3b: issue-registry.json MERGE orphan issues (them vao .issues[] voi ISSUE-NNN moi, severity=MEDIUM, fixability=AUTO_FIX, batch=2 cho ORPHAN_UI_ACTION / ESCALATE cho ORPHAN_UI_SCREEN)
fix-status.json.issues.by_orphan_type updated

test_cases.name: Resume sau khi triage bi gian doan giua chung
test_cases.description: Session truoc da tao bug-triage.md partial nhung chua hoan tat POST-GATE
expected_behavior: Resume Logic detect phase_2.status='in_progress'
Hien thi: 'bug-triage.md partial tim thay. Regenerate tu dau hoac reuse?'
Default: regenerate tu Step 2.0 (triage la idempotent)
POST-GATE: tat ca 5 files valid (bug-triage + fix-plan + issue-registry + fix-log + phase-summary), fix-status.json updated

test_cases.name: Phase Summary BAT BUOC (CORE-028 + Protocol 14)
test_cases.description: phase-summary.md PHAI duoc tao sau khi POST-GATE pass. Tieng Viet, <=15 dong, non-technical. Fail → T011 retry x3, neu van fail → tao voi status='THAT BAI'.
expected_outputs: $SESSION_DIR/phase-summary.md (tieng Viet, <=15 dong noi dung, <=20 dong ke ca frontmatter)
expected_behavior: Step 2.8 chay SAU KHI POST-GATE T1-T3 pass (T4 = phase-summary check)
Noi dung: sections '## Da lam gi', '## Ket qua', '## Can luu y', '## Buoc tiep theo' — BAT BUOC co 3 trong 4 sections (grep)
Ngon ngu: tieng Viet thuan, non-technical (khong dung 'severity', 'fixability', thay bang 'muc do nghiem trong', 'kha nang tu sua')
Resume --resume: giu nguyen summary cu, chi update khi phase_2 complete (Protocol 14.3)
Orchestrator family: overwrite summary cua phase truoc (Lane Dispatch ghi truoc, wf-fix-triage ghi de)
POST-GATE T4: `test $LINES -le 20 && grep -q '## Da lam gi\|## Ket qua\|## Buoc tiep theo' phase-summary.md`
Protocol 14.4: Hien thi noi dung inline trong conversation sau khi WRITE
failure_scenarios: Line count > 20 → T011 retry x3 → VAN tao voi status='THAT BAI' (Protocol 14.1 exception)
Template sai sections → T011 retry x3
Write fail (permission/disk) → retry → neu van fail → log FAIL trace va abort
